hypothesis.statement: Reconstruction needs isolated subjects, but using AI-edited RGB would silently alter the established identity and body evidence.
hypothesis.action: Use generated chroma edits only as alpha proposals, discard their RGB, combine alpha with bit-exact canonical RGB and expose source/checker/alpha boards for human review.
hypothesis.expectedResult: Draft RGBA inputs preserve every original RGB pixel while making matte defects visible and preventing automatic approval.

canonical03.visualFinding: major silhouette retained; some flyaway-hair boundaries are thickened

canonical16.visualFinding: body silhouette retained; shoelace and finger-gap boundaries are simplified

decision: Keep both non-destructive drafts and review boards. Do not feed them to TRELLIS or InstantMesh until a named reviewer accepts or manually corrects the alpha boundaries.
